item.tib: mkha' 'gro grib sel gyi tshe dbang rtog 'joms
item.coloph: ces pa lha bu spa ba spa thog kyi gdung la son pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa a yu khi khar gyis bskul ngor rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis dpal gyi ri bo mdun zhol sngon tshe mkhas pa mi bzhi'i sgrub phug tu shing bya bdag pa zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gsum pa'i gral tshes su gtan la dbab ste/ drung yig pa ni lha bla tshe dbang rgyal mtshan gyis bgyis pa dge legs su gyur cig/

item.tib: mkha' 'gro grib sel gyi tshe dbang rtog 'joms
